info.title: go-ined API
info.description: REST and Server-Sent Events API of ined-server. Specification: architecture/Spec.md (SPEC-501..509).

get.description: Works without a token; details only with a valid token.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: a view id; default the network view (1)

get.description: Server-Sent Events (SPEC-502). Event types: host.created, host.updated, host.status (Host); host.deleted, group.deleted, view.deleted (DeletedEvent); group.created, group.updated (Group); group.status (GroupStatusEvent); group.moved (GroupMovedEvent); map.arranged (MapArrangedEvent); view.created, view.updated (View); placement.updated (Placement); placement.deleted (PlacementDeletedEvent); discovery.progress, discovery.finished (Discovery); service.status (ServiceStatusEvent); resync (ResyncEvent). Event ids are <run>-<seq>; send Last-Event-ID to resume (SPEC-503).

post.summary: Check now which of SSH (22), RDP (3389), VNC (5900-5909), HTTP (80) and HTTPS (443) accept a TCP connection, save and return the host (SPEC-309, SPEC-511). Takes about the connect timeout (1 s). 503 when services.enabled = false.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: a view id; default the network view (1)

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: required when the group isn't empty (SPEC-104, 120)

post.summary: Move a group with everything in it

delete.summary: Delete a custom view with its groups and placements

put.summary: Place a host in a custom view

delete.summary: Remove a host from a custom view

post.summary: Lay out a group's members (or the root) on a grid
Copy a group of another view, with its subgroups and host placements, into this custom view (SPEC-729)

get.summary: Export a group of the network view with its subgroups, hosts and their custom-view placements (SPEC-513). Allowed with the read-only token.

post.summary: Import a network export below a group of the network view, in one step (SPEC-513). Bodies up to 32 MiB. 409 with the error and the report when it conflicts and update is false; a dry run always answers 200.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: The group to import into; absent = the top level.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The top group's position; give x and y, or neither.

parameters.name: update
parameters.description: Update matching items instead of refusing.

bearer.description: Required when the server has a token (SPEC-802).

Host.description: A host (SPEC-101). parent_id, x and y are its place in the network view.

display_name.description: manual name, else PTR name, else IP (SPEC-402)

views.description: views the host is placed in, network view first (SPEC-509)

services.description: services whose TCP port answered at the last check: ssh, rdp, vnc (5900), vnc:1..vnc:9 (5901-5909), http, https; null while never checked (SPEC-309)

services_checked_at.description: time of the last service check; null = never (SPEC-309)

watch.description: watched services with their status, in the order given; [] when none (SPEC-310)

Group.description: A group; with a cidr it is a network group (SPEC-102).

labels.description: Host label mode (SPEC-725): what the GUI shows under the hosts inside the group. "" = as the parent group (at the root: "name"); "name" = the display name; "ip" = the IP address; "both" = the display name and the IP address

color.description: The colour of the group's top bar in the GUI (SPEC-727): "#RRGGBB" (stored in upper case) or "" (none: the usual frame colour)

labels.description: groups only (SPEC-725); left out when empty

color.description: groups only (SPEC-727): the top bar's colour, "#RRGGBB"; left out when none

services_down.description: hosts only: watched services that are down (SPEC-310); 0 for groups

HostCreate.description: Body of POST /hosts. Without parent_id the host goes into the most specific network group (SPEC-107).

HostPatch.description: Body of PATCH /hosts/{id}: only the fields present change. null is allowed only for parent_id (the root). A new parent without x/y puts the host next to it (SPEC-508).

watch.description: replaces the watched services (SPEC-310): ssh, rdp, vnc, vnc:1..vnc:9, http, https or tcp:N; no port twice; [] watches nothing

GroupCreate.description: Body of POST /groups. Name defaults to the CIDR.

labels.description: Host label mode (SPEC-725): what the GUI shows under the hosts inside the group. "" = as the parent group (at the root: "name"); "name" = the display name; "ip" = the IP address; "both" = the display name and the IP address. Default ""

color.description: The colour of the group's top bar in the GUI (SPEC-727): "#rrggbb" (stored in upper case) or "" (none). Default ""

GroupPatch.description: Body of PATCH /groups/{id}: only the fields present change; "cidr": "" clears the CIDR; null only for parent_id. A new parent takes the group's contents along (SPEC-508); x/y alone move only the group.

labels.description: Host label mode (SPEC-725): what the GUI shows under the hosts inside the group. "" = as the parent group (at the root: "name"); "name" = the display name; "ip" = the IP address; "both" = the display name and the IP address

color.description: The colour of the group's top bar in the GUI (SPEC-727): "#rrggbb" (stored in upper case) or "" (none)

contents_only.description: move only what is inside the group, not the group (v0.29)

View.description: A view: one map, one GUI tab (SPEC-117).

ViewCreate.description: Body of POST /views. Without order the view goes last.

Placement.description: A host's place in a custom view (SPEC-119).

PlacementSet.description: Body of PUT /views/{id}/hosts/{host_id}. Without parent_id: the view's root. Without x/y: a free position for a new placement or a new parent.

DiscoveryCreate.description: Body of POST /discovery: a cidr or the group_id of an IPv4 network group; parent_id is the group a new network group goes under (SPEC-201).

Discovery.description: A discovery job (SPEC-205); also the payload of discovery.progress and discovery.finished.

errors.description: probes that failed with an error

Health.description: GET /health. Without a valid token only status and version (SPEC-501, 802).

access.description: What the token may do: full, or read for server.read_token (SPEC-808).

DeletedEvent.description: Payload of host.deleted, group.deleted and view.deleted.

GroupMovedEvent.description: Payload of group.moved: everything inside the group moved by dx, dy (SPEC-507).

ResyncEvent.description: Payload of resync: reload the full state (SPEC-503).

Arrange.description: Body of POST /views/{id}/arrange (SPEC-510): lay out the direct members of a group (parent_id null: the view's root) on a grid; 0 sizes mean the normal grid (100 x 80).

MapArrangedEvent.description: Payload of map.arranged: the members of a group (parent_id null: the root) were laid out again; reload the view (SPEC-510).

GroupCopy.description: Body of POST /views/{id}/copy-group (SPEC-729): the group to copy; it must belong to another view.

GroupCopyResult.description: Answer of POST /views/{id}/copy-group: the new top group, the groups and host placements made, and how many of those hosts were in the view already and moved into the copy.

WatchedService.description: A watched service of a host and its status (SPEC-310).

name.description: ssh, rdp, vnc, vnc:1..vnc:9, http, https or tcp:N

status.description: unknown until checked, and while the host is not monitored

last_change.description: when the status last changed; null = never

last_ok.description: when the port last accepted a connection; null = never

ServiceStatusEvent.description: Payload of service.status: a watched service changed status (SPEC-311).

services_down.description: The host's number of watched services down after this change, as in /map items (v0.51).

NetworkExport.description: A network export file (SPEC-513, Design-network-export.md N5): one group of the network view with everything below it. format is "go-ined-network", version 1.

from.description: Where the group was, "Networks › dc › lan"; information only.

ExportGroup.description: A group in an export, with its subgroups and hosts; positions relative to the exported group, which is at 0, 0.

ExportHost.description: A host in an export: its own fields, without what the server measures.

ExportPlacement.description: A host's place in a custom view, by the view's name and the group names from its top level down.

ExportViewGroup.description: A group of a custom view on a placement's path, so an import can make it when missing; path ends with its name.

ImportCounts.description: Items of an import: groups and hosts of the network view, groups in custom views, placements in custom views.

ImportReport.description: What an import did or would do (N7). conflicts lists the first 50; more_conflicts counts the rest.

ImportConflict.description: Body of a 409 from POST /import: the usual error (code conflict) with the report, which lists the conflicts.
